reasons.detail: Model returned seasonStartMonth 5 quoting "ouvert de mai à septembre". That string does not appear in kobawakepark.fr after whitespace normalisation (sha256:c1d4e7…). Treated as fabricated; nothing written.
tripadvisor.fr is a review site. Not T1, T2 or T3 — reviewer-entered prices are not operator tariffs regardless of how plausible they look.
amount 30 quoted from "formule à partir de 25 €". 30 is not the number in the quote, and "à partir de" is a floor rather than a tariff.
yearRound true was inferred from the absence of closing dates on the homepage. Absence of a stated closure is not a statement of opening.
